title: Graham Malice - Notice (Feat. capshun & Zayland)
htmlContent:
Graham Malice, capshun & Zayland come together to make music you can feel on the new song “Notice”. The record grabs you right away, with the driving work, that are met with capshun & Zayland’s scratching to let you know, that high class of sophistication that you are about to get. As soon as they rhyming starts it’s powerful, with commanding flows that deliver the high powered rhyming, to the fullest on what is a supreme display of Hip Hop music
